metadata.siteDescription: Johnny's Classical Music Space — A curated collection of piano, violin, and chamber music.

scores.title: Scores
scores.subtitle: Open or reference your PDF score library

quest.title: Ear Quest
quest.subtitle: Hear a phrase, play it back on your violin. You are graded on the sound that actually leaves the instrument — pitch, note order and rhythm ratios, measured in cents.

1.name: Groping
1.blurb: One position, stepwise motion. Build the hear-it-then-find-it reflex.

2.name: Leaps
2.blurb: Thirds, fourths and fifths. Interval recognition proper.

3.name: Rhythm
3.blurb: Unequal note values. The long-short ratios have to be clean.

4.name: Transposition
4.blurb: The same shape, moved to another key.

5.name: Shifting
5.blurb: Past first position. The hand has to travel.

6.name: Repertoire
6.blurb: Longer phrases, closer to real music.

quest.startHint: Ready when you are — current world: {world}
quest.micNotice: The browser will ask for microphone access the first time you record. Echo cancellation, noise suppression and auto gain are all switched off — they are tuned for speech and will wreck the pitch.

errors.mic: Could not open the microphone. Check the browser permission and your input device.
errors.grading: Analysis failed. Try another phrase; if it keeps happening, send me the console log.
errors.insecureContext: This page is not a secure context, so the browser will refuse microphone access. Open it over https:// or http://localhost.

feedback.noNotes: No usable notes detected — check the microphone, the room noise, or whether the violin is in tune.
feedback.badlyTuned: Right note, badly out of tune: {items}
feedback.extraNotes: {count} extra notes — hunting for the pitch is normal, but it costs a little.
feedback.openStringDetuned: ⚠️ The {strings} open string is systematically off — that means the violin has drifted, not you. Retune before practising, or none of this intonation data is trustworthy.
feedback.systematicSharp: You are {cents} cents sharp overall — that is a systematic offset. Check the open strings first, then the hand frame.
feedback.systematicFlat: You are {cents} cents flat overall — that is a systematic offset. Check the open strings first, then the hand frame.
feedback.rhythmUnsteady: The long-short ratios are not steady yet — put a metronome on and slow it down until the durations are clean.
